name: Via Ba at Ba Den
nameVi: Lễ vía Bà Linh Sơn Thánh Mẫu
summary: The pilgrimage of Bà Linh Sơn Thánh Mẫu at Chùa Bà and Điện Bà on Ba Den falls on lunar days 4, 5, and 6 of the fifth month. In 2026 the management program ran 18–20 June, the operator’s side-event page 18–22 June, and a Sun World article 18–21 June. The heritage page puts the bath of the statue at 0:00 on the 4th. The 2026 program puts it at 18:00 on 18 June. Both hours stay. The next solar date is check on arrival.
when: Lunar 4, 5, and 6 of the fifth month. 2026 windows: 18–20 June, 18–22 June, and 18–21 June. Bath at 0:00 on the 4th, and at 18:00 on 18 June 2026. Later years: check on arrival.
